products.title: Puerto Morelos Reef Snorkeling Adventure with beachside lunch

Join us for an unforgettable 80-minute snorkeling adventure at one of the reef's best spots. Afterward, satisfy your appetite with a delightful beachside lunch at a local restaurant.

products.title: Horseback Riding & ATV Jungle Adventure with Zipline, Cenote & Tequila Tasting
products.description:
Set off to El Rey Polo Club to explore the verdant area on a horseback, trotting your way through the forest on quaint dusty roads. The experience is ideal for both experienced and novice riders, making it a great way to try horse riding for the first time.

The adventure continues at the Extreme Adventure Park with a fun-packed ATV ride. Your knowledgeable guide takes you through the deep jungle to explore the region's flora and fauna. Watch out for monkeys swinging through the trees and toucans flying past as you race over rugged dirt trails.

products.title: Chichen Itza Classic Cenote & Valladolid Tour
products.description:
Are you ready for a journey that will ignite your senses and stir your soul? Join us on an extraordinary expedition through time as we uncover the mysteries of the Mayan world and explore the wonders of the Yucatan Peninsula.


Our adventure begins in the quaint Mayan village of Ebtun, where you'll be welcomed with open arms and treated to a feast of authentic flavors during a delicious lunch. Feel the pulse of ancient traditions as you immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of this enchanting community.


But the excitement doesn't end there.


Next, we'll whisk you away to the picturesque colonial town of Valladolid, where cobblestone streets and pastel-colored buildings beckon you to wander and explore. Lose yourself in the charm of this historic gem before we venture onwards to the crown jewel of our journey: Chichén Itzá.


Prepare to be amazed as you step foot into this legendary ancient city, where towering pyramids and intricate stone carvings whisper tales of the mayan civilization. Our expert guides will lead you on a comprehensive tour, unveiling the secrets of the iconic Kukulkan Pyramid, the majestic Ball Court, the revered Temple of the Warriors, and the mystical Sacred Cenote.


As the day draws to a close, we'll make one final stop at the breathtaking Cenote Xcajum, a natural wonder that invites you to take a refreshing dip in its crystal-clear waters. Let the beauty of the cenote rejuvenate your spirit before we bid farewell to this unforgettable journey.


Don't miss your chance to embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Book your place now and prepare to be mesmerized by the magic of Chichén Itzá, cenotes, and colonial charm!

products.description:
Cruise the scenic Nichupte Lagoon and the Caribbean Sea in a unique glass boat with an incredible 360 visibility. With its completely transparent hull, the one-of-a-kind vessel takes you on en exciting sightseeing journey in Cancun.

The adults onboard can enjoy a beer or two, courtesy by the boat captain.

An Unforgettable Mexican Fiesta on the Water in Xoximilco

Get ready to experience the magic of a true Mexican party — not just on land, but floating through the vibrant canals of Xoximilco Cancun, one of the most authentic and festive attractions in the Riviera Maya. When you book your Xoximilco tour through What To Do In

Cancun, you're signing up for an evening filled with traditional culture, delicious food, and joyful celebration in a unique and unforgettable setting.


Step aboard a brightly decorated Mexican gondola (trajinera), inspired by the original boats from Xochimilco in Mexico City. As you cruise under the stars through scenic canals, your evening will come alive with live mariachi music, traditional games, and the laughter of fellow

travelers — guided all the way by a charismatic personal host who ensures your experience is both entertaining and smooth.


What kind of food and drinks are served at Xoximilco?

Your journey through Xoximilco Park includes a full tasting menu of authentic Mexican dishes — from street-style snacks to rich regional specialties like tamales, cochinita pibil, mole, and more. The evening is also fueled by an open bar with unlimited beer and tequila, perfect to raise your glass and toast to a night of cultural discovery and pure fun.


Whether you're traveling as a couple, with friends, or celebrating something special, this tour offers a perfect mix of folklore, flavor, and fiesta. It’s a celebration of Mexico’s heart and soul — shared in the most joyful way possible.


Please note: Each trajinera has a maximum capacity of 3,000 kg, which is around 20 people per boat, ensuring plenty of space to dance, eat, and enjoy comfortably.

If you're looking for a different kind of evening experience that blends culture, cuisine, and community, Xoximilco Cancun is one of the most unique tours in Cancun. Book now with What To Do In Cancun and let the good times flow — literally!

Located just 1 hour and 15 minutes from Cancun, the Río Secreto Nature Reserve lies near Playa del Carmen and offers a stunning underground world unlike anything you’ve ever seen. Wondering how far is Río Secreto from Cancun? It's close enough for a comfortable

products.description:
This surreal journey begins with a visit to Tulum, home to one of the most iconic and picturesque archaeological sites in all of Mexico. Perched high on a cliff overlooking the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea, Tulum offers breathtaking views and a fascinating

look into the legacy of the ancient Maya civilization. Although compact in size, the site is rich in historical significance and scenic beauty, making it a perfect introduction to the wonders that await underground.


After exploring Tulum, your adventure continues at the Río Secreto Nature Reserve, located just a short drive away. So, what is the Río Secreto tour and what makes it unique? It’s a guided exploration into a magical underground world—one that has been carved by nature

The Río Secreto tour is suitable for nature lovers, curious travelers, and adventure seekers alike. Whether you’re marveling at the underground formations or floating peacefully in the cool freshwater, every moment at Río Secreto Tulum is designed to leave a lasting impression. Your expert guide will provide fascinating insights into the geological and cultural importance of the site, helping you fully appreciate this living natural museum.


This tour also includes all necessary equipment—such as wetsuits, life jackets, helmets with headlamps, and towels—as well as a delicious buffet meal after the tour. You'll travel comfortably between destinations and return with a deeper understanding of the region's unique history and ecology.

products.description:

who climb its steps. Walking or biking through these ancient grounds gives you a deep sense of connection with a civilization that thrived centuries ago.


After your cultural exploration, the journey continues underground at Río Secreto, an extraordinary natural wonder near Playa del Carmen. Unlike any other cenote tour in the Riviera Maya, the Río Secreto tour invites you to travel through a mystical underground river

jacket, helmet with headlamp, and towels. Knowledgeable local guides provide insights into the geological and cultural significance of the reserve, enriching your appreciation of this hidden gem.


By the end of your tour, you’ll not only have explored two of the Riviera Maya’s most fascinating destinations—you’ll also walk away with a deeper understanding of our planet’s natural history and the spiritual beliefs of the ancient Maya.

Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers, this experience combines adventure, marine life, and the natural beauty of the Yucatán Peninsula.

products.title: Clearboat Tour with Reef Visit & Sandbar Swim in Cancun
products.excerpt: The Transparent Boat Tour in Cancun offers a unique experience aboard a fully transparent vessel, featuring guided reef exploration, a 20-minute sandbar swim, and included beverages for an immersive view of the Caribbean marine world.

Unlike traditional glass-bottom boat tours, this unforgettable experience surrounds you with crystal-clear views in every direction, creating the feeling of floating directly above the vibrant marine world.

Departing from Playa Tortugas, your journey takes you across the beautiful Caribbean Sea to explore colorful coral reefs, tropical fish, and Cancun's breathtaking underwater scenery while comfortably seated inside a fully transparent boat. Along the way, your local guide will share fascinating insights about the area's marine ecosystem and iconic landmarks.

Refreshing beverages are also included, making this the perfect activity for couples, families, and friends looking to experience Cancun from a completely different perspective.

Whether you're visiting Cancun for the first time or searching for a unique Caribbean adventure, the Transparent Boat Tour with Reef Visit & Sandbar Swim offers the perfect combination of sightseeing, relaxation, and unforgettable ocean views.
